resources.string: This app sends the standard network codes your carrier already uses for call forwarding — the same codes used when dialing them manually. No internet connection is required, and no data leaves your phone.
To send and read forwarding codes, this app needs permission to make calls. It is only used for the network codes shown below.
Every incoming call is forwarded immediately, with no ringing on this phone.
Calls are forwarded only while you\'re already on another call.
Calls are forwarded if you don\'t answer after a few rings.
Calls are forwarded when your phone is off or out of coverage.
Turns on busy, unanswered, and unreachable forwarding together, in one step.

Couldn\'t read it automatically. On o2, your mailbox number is usually your own number with 33 inserted after the prefix (e.g. 0176 33 xxxxxxx) — 13 if your number came from Telekom, or 55 from Vodafone. You can also just dial 333 to reach it directly.
Couldn\'t reach the network — please try again
Opened in your Phone app — press call to continue
One code to switch off all forwarding types at once (##002#).
These are standard network codes, sent directly over the phone network — no internet required.
